title: BuildTarget
description: Descriptor for a single coreos-assembler (COSA) build target. It binds a SourceOS flavor, an OSTree ref, and a package manifest to a concrete set of output artifacts for one architecture. This is artifact-truth input: it declares WHAT cosa should produce. Build orchestration and promotion live downstream in SociOS-Linux/socios.

flavorRef.description: Path to the Flavor descriptor this target composes, relative to repo root.

ostreeRef.description: OSTree ref / branch the composed tree is committed to.

packageManifestRef.description: Path to the top-level cosa/rpm-ostree manifest (manifest.yaml / treefile) consumed by `cosa build`, relative to repo root.

architecture.description: Target architecture. Note: COSA must run on a build host of this arch (cross-build is not supported by this wrapper).

baseStream.description: Upstream FCOS stream the substrate derives from. Advisory; the manifest is authoritative.

outputFormats.description: Artifact formats cosa should build. Each maps to a `cosa buildextend-<fmt>` (or the base `cosa build` for ostree/qemu).

katelloRepos.description: Maps output formats to the Katello custom-file repo each artifact is uploaded into downstream. Read by the wiring layer in socios; the format keys MUST be a subset of outputFormats.

channel.description: Release channel this build targets. Matches channels/<name>.yaml.

signing.description: Artifact signing posture. TODO(cosign): signing is wired by a separate task; this block is descriptor-only and currently advisory.
